en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play basketball
Ah, maybe we should take off our clothes...?
Let's warm up a bit

Screw that. What if I sprain a finger
on one of my godly hands?

I wouldn't be able to invent anything!
Oh, how the world would suffer!

Don't act like your stubby fingers
even compare to mine!
Wh-Why do I gotta take 'em off here!?
Q-Quit starin' at me...

I'll take 'em off...
Just...quit starin' at me like that!

Let's get to bendin'! You gotta loosen
things up before you jam it in!

<CLT=cltMIND>As Miu bent over, I cautiously
pushed on her back to help her stretch...

Hngh...grgh...OUCH!
I can't bend that direction!
<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
(Hmph...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Miu's inner thoughts...?
